name: digital-workforce
description: Digital Workforce Live - a player-run office economy for friends (Netlify + Supabase)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.play: npm run build && npm run start
